description: The pie chart titled "Token Routing Distribution (FedHLM)" represents the distribution of token routing in a federated learning system. The chart is divided into three slices, each representing a different routing method. The largest slice, occupying 94.5% of the chart, is labeled "LOCAL" and is colored green. The second largest slice, colored red, represents "LLM" and accounts for 3.9% of the chart. The smallest slice, colored blue, is labeled "EDGE_P2P" and makes up 1.6% of the chart. There are no percentage labels inside the slices, and no legend is present. The slices are not visually emphasized in any particular way.
